rule: Use sticky navigation on long pages
do_pattern: Sticky header that stays visible on scroll
do_code: position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50; backdrop-filter: blur(8px);

rule: Add breadcrumbs for deep hierarchies
do_pattern: Show path: Home > Category > Item

rule: Use smooth scroll for anchor links
do_pattern: Smooth scroll to sections on click

rule: Mobile hamburger menu with clear icon
do_pattern: Standard hamburger icon with smooth open animation

rule: Keep animations under 300ms for interactions
do_pattern: Quick responsive micro-interactions

rule: Respect reduced motion preferences
do_pattern: Check and disable animations for accessibility
dont_code: /* Triggers motion sickness for some users */

rule: Use ease-out for entering elements
do_pattern: Elements enter smoothly and decelerate

rule: Stagger animations for list items
do_pattern: Items appear in sequence with slight delay

rule: Always use visible labels above inputs
do_pattern: Label clearly above the input field

rule: Show inline validation errors immediately
do_pattern: Error appears below the specific field in red
dont_pattern: Show all errors at top of form only
dont_code: /* User can't find which field failed */

rule: Use appropriate input types for mobile
do_pattern: Email type shows @ keyboard on mobile
dont_pattern: Generic text input for all fields

rule: Group related fields visually
do_pattern: Fieldset with legend for related inputs
dont_pattern: All fields in one flat list

rule: Auto-focus first field on form pages
do_pattern: Focus the first input when page loads

rule: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text
do_pattern: Dark text on light backgrounds or vice versa
dont_pattern: Low contrast text on similar backgrounds

rule: All images must have alt text
do_pattern: Descriptive alt text for meaningful images

rule: Keyboard navigation must work for all interactive elements
do_pattern: Focusable buttons links and inputs with visible focus ring

rule: Use semantic HTML elements
do_pattern: Proper heading hierarchy and landmarks

rule: Touch targets minimum 44x44px on mobile
do_pattern: Large enough buttons for finger tapping
dont_pattern: Tiny buttons or links on mobile
dont_code: padding: 4px 8px; /* Too small to tap accurately */

rule: Lazy load images below the fold
do_pattern: Load images only when entering viewport
dont_pattern: Load all images on page load

rule: Use skeleton screens during loading
do_pattern: Show content shape placeholder while loading

rule: Optimize images with modern formats
do_pattern: WebP or AVIF with fallback

rule: Implement virtual scrolling for long lists
do_pattern: Render only visible items in viewport
do_code: Use react-virtual or tanstack-virtual for lists over 100 items

rule: Use a clear type scale with consistent ratios
do_pattern: Progressive heading sizes with 1.25 ratio

rule: Line height 1.5-1.8 for body text
do_pattern: Comfortable reading line height
dont_pattern: Cramped or overly loose line spacing

rule: Limit line length to 50-75 characters
do_pattern: Constrain text width for readability

rule: Use color consistently for meaning
do_pattern: Green = success / Red = error / Yellow = warning
dont_code: /* Green button = success AND navigation? Confusing */

rule: Never rely on color alone for information
do_pattern: Add icons or text labels alongside color
dont_code: Email required /* Colorblind users miss it */

rule: Limit palette to 5-7 colors max
do_pattern: Primary + Secondary + Accent + Neutral shades
do_code: Define CSS variables for consistent palette usage
dont_code: /* Every section uses different random colors */

rule: Use clear visual hierarchy for button importance
do_pattern: Primary (filled) > Secondary (outlined) > Tertiary (ghost)

rule: Show loading state during async actions
do_pattern: Spinner or progress indicator inside button

rule: Use descriptive button labels not just OK/Cancel
do_pattern: Action-specific labels tell user what happens

rule: Use consistent spacing scale (4px base)
do_pattern: Tailwind-style 4px spacing scale

rule: Use more whitespace not less
do_pattern: Generous padding around content sections
do_code: padding: 96px 0; /* Section spacing */ gap: 48px; /* Content spacing */

rule: Mobile-first approach always
do_pattern: Start with mobile layout and add breakpoints up

rule: Test on real devices not just browser resize
do_pattern: Physical device testing for touch and performance
do_code: Use BrowserStack or physical devices for QA

rule: Stack columns on mobile to single column
do_pattern: Flexible grid that adapts to screen size

rule: Show toast notifications for async actions
do_pattern: Non-blocking notification on action success/failure

rule: Use optimistic updates for perceived speed
do_pattern: Update UI immediately then sync with server
dont_pattern: Wait for server response before updating UI
dont_code: await api.create(newItem); setItems(await api.list()); /* Feels slow */

rule: Show empty states with helpful actions
do_pattern: Guide users when content is empty
do_code: <EmptyState icon={Plus} message="No projects yet" action="Create first project" />
dont_pattern: Blank white screen when no data
